text: Steenbarger: no, h1_close_above:bar_high carries no volume test, and my own canon sides with oneil and minervini. Elder's persistence test is a volume test (C23): contraction at a fresh extreme warns of a pause, and day_vol 0.51 at D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.13 is that. elder_5d [10,10,10,7,7] is green fading, no transition (C4). Clears with a daily close over Friday's high on day_vol above 1, or the pullback into the 20-day value zone while elder holds not-red. Until then I read it as WATCH. Wrong if elder prints red or a daily close below base_low_20d.
